```{python}
#| label: setup
import os
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

```

## Methods

### Data acquisition

The raw data are saved, unmodified, in `data/raw/`.

```{python}
#| label: load-raw
data = "../data/raw/AmesHousing.csv"
raw = pd.read_csv(data)
```

### Cleaning

We keep only the target (sale price) and the three features in our question,
and give them short, consistent names.
We then check that the columns are numeric, that there are no missing values,
and that there are no duplicated rows.

```{python}
#| label: clean-data
cleaned = raw[["Gr Liv Area", "Overall Qual", "SalePrice"]].copy()
cleaned.columns = ["living_area", "overall_quality", "sale_price"]
cleaned["house_age"] = 2026 - raw["Year Built"]

os.makedirs("../data/processed", exist_ok=True)
cleaned.to_csv("../data/processed/ames_cleaned.csv", index=False)
cleaned.shape
```
